cli.description: Galivelop IG: local AI image generator (queue, attempts, chosen candidate and delivery).
cli.help.lang: language of the messages (default: the system's)
cli.cmd.project_add: register the project in a folder
cli.cmd.order_submit: create or update an order and queue its attempts
cli.cmd.order_list: list the orders of a project
cli.cmd.order_show: show an order with its attempts
cli.cmd.attempt_new: queue new attempts (random seed unless --seed is given)
cli.cmd.attempt_mark: mark an attempt as new, candidate or discarded
cli.cmd.attempt_note: set the note of an attempt
cli.cmd.choose: choose an attempt and deliver it to the project
cli.cmd.compose: compose an attempt again from its raw image, without generating (the chosen one is delivered again)
cli.arg.file: order JSON file, or - for standard input
cli.arg.attempt_optional: attempt number (default: the chosen one, else the last)
cli.arg.text_kv: text field to set, as FIELD=TEXT (repeatable; it is saved in the order)
cli.arg.chosen: only orders with a chosen attempt
cli.arg.unchosen: only orders without a chosen attempt
cli.arg.draft: generate drafts (smaller and fewer steps, D32); --no-draft forces final images
cli.out.composed_delivered: Composed attempt {id} and delivered it again: {path}
error.cli.text_invalid: "{value}" is not FIELD=TEXT (use for example --text title="My title")

cli.cmd.brand: brand process: remove the background, turn into SVG and the name as paths
cli.cmd.brand_matte: remove the flat background of a PNG and save it with transparency (the original is not touched)
cli.cmd.brand_trace: turn a PNG into a vector SVG (color, mono or silhouette)
cli.cmd.brand_wordmark: the brand name in a font, turned into paths (an SVG with no text and no dependency on the font)
cli.arg.brand_out_matte: output PNG (default: next to the original with the suffix -alpha)
cli.arg.brand_out_svg: output SVG (default: next to the PNG; for wordmark, wordmark.svg)
cli.arg.brand_tol: color distance (0-441) under which a pixel connected to the border is background (default 60)
cli.arg.brand_soft: distance from which an edge pixel is fully opaque (larger than --tol; default 110)
cli.arg.brand_border: border pixels the background color is taken from (default 6)
cli.arg.brand_grow: pixels the background eats over the soft edge (default 3)
cli.arg.brand_mode: color (one layer per color), mono (one path) or silhouette (the whole shape)
cli.arg.brand_palette: palette colors, separated by commas (not with --colors)
cli.arg.brand_colors: number of colors taken from the image (default 4)
cli.arg.brand_min_island: smallest island area; smaller ones are dropped (default 12)
cli.arg.brand_matte: remove the flat background first (for a PNG with an opaque background)
cli.arg.brand_weight: font weight, 1-1000 (default 800; a variable font applies it)
cli.arg.brand_spacing: letter spacing in em (default 0.01, the family's)
cli.arg.brand_mono_lockup: the lockups with the mono emblem: the whole lockup in currentColor, as the family's sheets ask
cli.out.brand_opaque: the PNG has no transparency: if it has a background, repeat with --matte
error.brand.out_is_input: the output "{path}" is the original itself: pick another -o so it is not overwritten
error.brand.tool_missing: the tool "{tool}" is missing for the name as paths (install it; "gimg doctor" says how)
error.brand.timeout: {tool} took over {seconds} s drawing the name
error.brand.text_too_long: the name is too long (at most {max} characters)
error.brand.empty_wordmark: the font "{family}" drew nothing with that text (does it lack those letters?)
error.brand.wordmark_no_fit: the name does not fit when drawn: {reason}
cli.cmd.brand_lockup: joins the emblem SVG and the wordmark SVG into one SVG (h: side by side; v: one under the other), all paths
cli.cmd.brand_system: the logo system from the emblem PNG: transparent PNG, color and mono emblem, wordmark, two lockups and a contact sheet
cli.arg.brand_layout: h: emblem on the left, wordmark on the right; v: emblem on top, wordmark below (default h)
cli.arg.brand_margin: free space around, in emblem diameters (default 0)
cli.arg.brand_ink: color of the wordmark instead of currentColor (#rgb, #rrggbb or a name)
cli.arg.brand_cap: in h, height of the wordmark in emblem diameters (default 0.45)
cli.arg.brand_gap: gap between emblem and wordmark in emblem diameters (default 0.25)
cli.arg.brand_width: in v, width of the wordmark in emblem diameters (default 1.6)
cli.arg.brand_name: brand name (the file prefix is its slug, accents removed)
cli.arg.brand_wordmark_text: text of the wordmark (default: the name in capitals)
cli.arg.brand_holes: also treat as background what is not connected to the border but looks like it (a ring closed between shapes)
cli.arg.brand_force: overwrite the files already in the folder
error.brand.bad_svg: '{path}' does not work for the lockup: {reason}
error.brand.exists: '{folder}' already has {files}: use --force to overwrite them or pick another folder
error.brand.no_matte: '{path}' has no flat background to cut out (only {transparent} % ends up transparent): check the background or tune 'brand matte'
error.brand.bad_name: the name '{name}' gives no file prefix (it needs ASCII letters or digits once accents are removed)
error.brand.missing_piece: '{file}' is missing: do the '{step}' step of the brand first
error.brand.dir_missing: project '{project}' declares no 'brand.dir' in its configuration: there is no project folder to save the brand in
error.brand.no_palette: project '{project}' declares no 'brand.palette': use 'colors' or declare the palette
error.brand.font_unknown: no installed font has the family '{font}'
ui.brand.shop.title: Logo system
ui.brand.shop.intro: From the chosen attempt to the whole system: remove the background, trace to SVG, wordmark, lockups and save. Each step leaves its copy in the brand workshop and never touches the source attempt; any step can be repeated with other values.
ui.brand.shop.name: Brand name
ui.brand.shop.nameHint: With the project name first, so brands do not mix. It gives the workshop folder its name.
ui.brand.shop.s1Intro: The attempt the emblem comes from; chosen ones come first.
ui.brand.shop.s2Intro: Cuts the flat background out of the attempt and leaves a transparent PNG.
ui.brand.shop.borderHint: Border pixels used to measure the background.
ui.brand.shop.noPiece: This piece does not exist yet.
ui.brand.shop.s3Intro: Traces the cut-out emblem in color and in a single ink.
ui.brand.shop.s4Intro: The name drawn as paths with an installed typeface.
ui.brand.shop.wtextHint: Defaults to the name in uppercase.
ui.brand.shop.wfontHint: The profiles' fonts; any other installed one works too.
ui.brand.shop.wspacingHint: As a fraction of the body size.
ui.brand.shop.s5Intro: Emblem and wordmark together, horizontal and vertical.
ui.brand.shop.s6Intro: Contact sheet and the seven files of the system.
ui.brand.shop.noBrandDir: The project sets no brand.dir, so it can only be saved to gimg data.
ui.brand.shop.contactAlt: Contact sheet of the logo system
ui.brand.shop.busy: Another heavy job is running, retry in a few seconds.
ui.brand.shop.needTrace: Trace the emblem to color SVG first.
ui.attempt.forBrandHint: Opens the Brand tab with this attempt as the logo source
cli.cmd.queue_pause: pause the queue: the image in progress finishes and no other starts
cli.out.queue_paused: Queue paused: the image in progress finishes and no other starts. `gimg queue resume` resumes it.
cli.out.queue_resumed: Queue resumed (the service, if alive, relaunches the worker in a few seconds; otherwise `gimg work`).
cli.out.queue_paused_note: The queue is paused (`gimg queue resume` resumes it).
